grounded_facts: Frigga comforts Odin by emphasizing that Thor will have Loki's counsel and urges him to have faith.
memories.memory_text: I heard Frigga tell Odin that I wouldn't be alone because Loki would be at my side to give me counsel, and she urged him to have faith in us.

grounded_facts: Thor enters the palace anteroom after arriving through the giant doors, dressed for ceremony and receiving wine, marking his formal approach to the throne room.
memories.memory_text: I entered the palace anteroom through the giant doors, walking forward in my ceremonial garb with Mjolnir in hand, and an attendant handed me a goblet of wine before I proceeded down the hall toward the throne room.

grounded_facts: Loki emerges from the shadows beside the banner bearing horned silhouette, joining Thor at the brazier, signaling the start of their interaction before the ceremony.
memories.memory_text: As I approached the brazier at the foot of the steps, I saw Loki emerge from the shadows beside the banner with the horned silhouette, joining me there in his ceremonial attire, ready for the ceremony ahead.

grounded_facts: Loki asks Thor if he is nervous, initiating banter that reveals their history and dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I remember Loki asking me if I was nervous, right before the ceremony—we were always needling each other like that.

grounded_facts: Loki counters Thor's boast by claiming credit for their escape in Nornheim, undermining Thor's narrative of heroism.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki claim he was the one who got us out of Nornheim with his smoke trick, trying to take credit for my fight.

grounded_facts: Loki uses illusion magic to turn wine into eels on the attendant's hand, frightening him in response to suppressed laughter.
Loki uses magic to transform the wine in the goblet into eels, terrifying the attendant, then reverts the illusion, demonstrating his power and mischievous nature.
memories.memory_text: I saw Loki turn the wine into eels on the attendant's hand, making him scream, and then laugh as he turned them back to wine with a gesture.

grounded_facts: Loki drops his playful demeanor and sincerely tells Thor that he loves him and has looked forward to this day, creating a moment of emotional vulnerability.
memories.memory_text: Loki told me he loved me and had looked forward to this day as long as I have, and I could see no trace of irony in his face—though I wondered if he was speaking from the heart or just being a very good liar.

grounded_facts: After Loki's heartfelt declaration, Thor searches his face and accepts the sentiment, placing a hand on his shoulder in gratitude.
memories.memory_text: After hearing Loki's words, I searched his face and believed him, so I placed my hand on his shoulder and told him thank you.

grounded_facts: Loki breaks the emotional moment by asking Thor to give him a kiss, reverting to mockery and testing boundaries.
memories.memory_text: I saw Loki break the moment by asking me to give him a kiss, reverting to mockery just when things felt real between us.

grounded_facts: Thor tells Loki to go ahead into the palace while he remains behind, creating physical and symbolic separation before the ceremony.
memories.memory_text: I told Loki to go ahead into the palace while I stayed behind, needing that space to myself before the ceremony.

grounded_facts: The brothers gather in the palace anteroom before a formal ceremony in the throne room, engaging in ritual preparation and emotional exchange.
memories.memory_text: I stood with my brother by the brazier, taking in the moment before the ceremony, and made final adjustments to my ceremonial wear as we prepared to enter the throne room together.

grounded_facts: Thor puts on his eagle-winged helmet, completing his ceremonial attire and signaling readiness for the event ahead.
memories.memory_text: I put on my eagle-winged helmet and made the final adjustments to my ceremonial wear, feeling ready for what was to come.

grounded_facts: Frigga observes and acknowledges Thor's nervousness, which he initially denies but implicitly accepts by admitting she cannot be fooled.
Frigga notices Thor's anxiety and comforts him, leading him to admit (indirectly) that he cannot hide his feelings from her.
memories.memory_text: I was trying to hide my nerves, drumming my fingers on Mjolnir's handle, but my mother saw right through me—when she said it was all right to be nervous, I denied it, but then admitted I could never fool her.

grounded_facts: Frigga tells Thor that he has something Odin never had—her as a mother—providing emotional strength before his meeting with Odin.
Frigga tells Thor he possesses something even Odin lacked—her as a mother—strengthening his sense of self-worth.
memories.memory_text: I remember my mother telling me that I have something even the great Allfather never had—her as my mother—and those words gave me strength before I faced Odin.

grounded_facts: After offering words of comfort and confidence, Frigga leaves, ending the private moment and prompting Thor to proceed.
memories.memory_text: After speaking to me with such love, I saw Frigga leave, ending our private moment and reminding me it was time to go to Odin.

grounded_facts: Odin appears on the throne in full ceremonial armor, showing no trace of weakness and exuding authority, marking his restoration to full power.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Odin sitting on the throne in full ceremonial armor, holding Gungnir before him, showing no sign of weakness and radiating authority as the true ruler of Asgard.

grounded_facts: Odin looks to Loki in concern over Thor's absence; Loki responds with a shrug, indicating uncertainty or indifference.
memories.memory_text: I wasn't there when Odin looked around for me, but I can imagine his concern and Loki's careless shrug—he probably didn't know where I was, or just didn't care to say.

grounded_facts: Thor arrives late to the throne room, making a showy entrance by flying in with Mjolnir and performing for the crowd.
memories.memory_text: I flew into the throne room late, riding Mjolnir and catching it behind my back, then spun it with a flourish to whip the crowd into a frenzy—I could hear them cheering and feel their adoration as I basked in the moment.

grounded_facts: A formal assembly in the throne room attended by Odin, Frigga, Loki, Sif, the Warriors Three, and the crowd, marked by ceremonial protocol and the presence of the Einherjar Honor Guard.
memories.memory_text: I saw the formal assembly in the throne room, with Odin, Frigga, Loki, Sif, the Warriors Three, and the crowd gathered around, all part of the ceremony with the Einherjar Honor Guard present.

grounded_facts: Thor finishes stirring the crowd and kneels on one knee before Odin and Frigga in the throne room.
memories.memory_text: I finished rousing the crowd and knelt on one knee before my parents in the throne room.

grounded_facts: Frigga gives Thor an admonishing glance, but smiles after he winks at her.
memories.memory_text: I saw my mother give me an admonishing look, so I winked at her, and I remember how she couldn't help but smile in return.

grounded_facts: A formal event in the Asgardian throne room where Odin addresses the legacy of Gungnir and introduces Mjolnir in the context of Thor's succession.
memories.memory_text: I was present when my father struck Gungnir on the ground and spoke of its legacy, then declared me his heir and first-born as he introduced Mjolnir.

grounded_facts: Odin formally asks Thor to swear oaths of responsibility, peace, and selfless rule before being crowned king.
memories.memory_text: I remember Odin asking me directly: 'Thor Odinson, do you swear to guard the Nine Realms? Do you swear to preserve the peace? Do you swear to cast aside all selfish ambition and pledge yourself only to the good of all the Realms?'

grounded_facts: A formal event in the Asgardian throne room where Thor is to be crowned the new king, symbolizing the transfer of power from Odin to the next generation.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the throne room, ready to be crowned king, with the weight of Asgard's legacy upon me, when I heard distant battle sounds echoing through the palace.

grounded_facts: Odin begins the coronation ceremony of Thor as the new king of Asgard, but it is abruptly interrupted by the appearance of frost creeping on banners and the sound of battle, indicating a Frost Giant intrusion.
memories.memory_text: I was in the hall as Odin began my coronation, feeling the weight of the moment, when I saw ice creeping across the banners and heard that eerie cracking sound; then I realized something was wrong and raced out to confront the threat, seeing Sif and the Warriors Three draw their weapons behind me.

grounded_facts: The Destroyer successfully defends the Vault by killing the Frost Giants who attempted to steal the Casket of Ancient Winters.
A group of Frost Giants infiltrates the Asgardian Weapons Vault in an attempt to reclaim the Casket of Ancient Winters, resulting in their destruction by The Destroyer.
memories.memory_text: I saw the aftermath of the battle in the Vault, where the Destroyer stood guarding the Casket of Ancient Winters after killing the Frost Giants who had broken in to steal it.

grounded_facts: Odin orders Sif and the Warriors Three to leave so he can speak privately with Thor and Loki.
memories.memory_text: I saw Odin turn to Sif and the Warriors Three and tell them to leave us, and then they exited, leaving me alone with him and Loki.

grounded_facts: Thor confronts Odin about the Frost Giant breach, demanding war and questioning the current rule.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Odin directly, questioning his rule and asserting my own authority as King of Asgard, demanding war against Jotunheim and challenging his judgment on how to handle the Frost Giant threat.

grounded_facts: Thor proposes a military invasion of Jotunheim to punish the Frost Giants, but Odin refuses, calling it an overreaction.
memories.memory_text: I stood before my father and demanded that we march into Jotunheim to punish the Frost Giants for their breach of Asgard, declaring they must pay for their actions and that I would lead the charge to break their spirits, but he rejected my proposal, calling it an overreaction and reminding me that I am not yet king.

grounded_facts: Odin shuts down Thor's call for war against Jotunheim, asserting his role as king and dismissing Thor's militaristic response.
memories.memory_text: I saw in my father's face that I had pushed too far when he shut down my call for war, asserting his role as king and dismissing my warrior's mindset, making it clear that my militaristic response would not be tolerated.

grounded_facts: Thor expresses his anger by flipping over a large banquet table in the empty hall.
memories.memory_text: I let my anger out by flipping over a massive banquet table in the empty hall.

grounded_facts: Thor warns Loki that it's unwise to be near him due to his current emotional state.
memories.memory_text: I told my brother it was unwise to be in my company right now, knowing my anger could spill over.

grounded_facts: A formal celebration in the banquet hall that was cancelled due to recent events, leaving behind scattered food and overturned tables.
memories.memory_text: I remember standing in the hall, seeing the scattered food and overturned tables after my celebration was cancelled—this was supposed to be my day of triumph.

grounded_facts: Thor resolves to travel to Jotunheim to confront the Frost Giants and secure Asgard's safety.
memories.memory_text: I declared that the safety of our Realm was no jest, and I resolved that we must go to Jotunheim to confront the Frost Giants.

grounded_facts: Thor persuades Sif, the Warriors Three, and Loki to accompany him to Jotunheim through emotional appeal and shared history.
Thor uses shared history to pressure his friends into joining the mission.
memories.memory_text: I looked at my friends and reminded them of all we've done together, urging them to trust me now—we had to do this. I challenged them not to let my brother and me take all the glory, and I could see them relent.

grounded_facts: An impromptu meeting in the banquet hall where Thor announces and rallies support for a mission to Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I announced to my companions that we're going to Jotunheim to protect Asgard, and I rallied them by reminding them they wouldn't let my brother and me take all the glory.

grounded_facts: Thor explicitly includes Loki in the mission to Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I turned to Loki and told him directly, 'You are coming with me,' making sure he knew there was no choice—he was part of this mission.

grounded_facts: Thor, Sif, Loki, and the Warriors Three prepare to leave Odin's Palace on a mission, equipping for battle.
memories.memory_text: I remember preparing to leave Odin's Palace with Sif, Loki, and the Warriors Three, gearing up for battle as we faced the daunting task ahead.

grounded_facts: Fandral makes a joke about Heimdall's supposed failure to detect Frost Giants, undermining his reputation.
memories.memory_text: I heard Fandral make a sarcastic remark, saying that getting past Heimdall should be simple because he's been letting Frost Giants sneak by under his nose.

grounded_facts: Volstagg, frightened by Fandral's remark, shouts to the sky asking Heimdall to forgive Fandral.
memories.memory_text: I saw Volstagg look frightened and shout to the sky, begging Heimdall to forgive Fandral because he didn't mean any offense.

grounded_facts: Thor and his companions leave Asgard through the Rainbow Bridge, marking the beginning of their journey beyond the realm.
memories.memory_text: I led my companions through the massive Gate and onto the Rainbow Bridge, riding out of Asgard to begin our journey beyond the realm.

grounded_facts: Heimdall uses hyperbolic sensory claims to expose Fandral's presence, undermining the group's attempt at secrecy.
memories.memory_text: I watched Heimdall fix his gaze on Fandral and say he could hear a cricket passing gas in Niffelheim, making it clear he knew we weren't being honest.

grounded_facts: Heimdall blocks the group's path and questions their intentions, revealing his awareness of their deception and the dangers of Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I saw Heimdall block our path and question our intentions, and I heard him warn us about the dangers of Jotunheim while standing firm at his post.

grounded_facts: Thor interrupts Loki's attempt to persuade Heimdall and directly demands passage, shifting the group's approach from subtlety to direct appeal.
memories.memory_text: I stepped forward and told Loki to stop, then I directly asked Heimdall for passage, shifting how we approached the situation.

grounded_facts: The group arrives at Heimdall's Observatory, seeking passage, leading to a confrontation and eventual approval to proceed.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at Heimdall's Observatory with the group, seeking passage, and I remember walking past him after he let us through.

grounded_facts: Heimdall allows Thor and the group to pass after Thor's direct appeal, marking a transition from obstruction to permission.
memories.memory_text: I walked past Heimdall after he allowed us through, knowing my appeal had succeeded and our path was now open.

grounded_facts: After Loki's failed negotiation, Volstagg ridicules him for losing his usual eloquence.
memories.memory_text: I saw Volstagg mock Loki for losing his silver tongue after the negotiation failed.

grounded_facts: Loki responds to Volstagg's mockery with a sarcastic comment about his weight.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki snap back at Volstagg with a sarcastic remark about the bridge cracking under his weight, which made the others laugh.

grounded_facts: A group led by Thor arrives at Heimdall's Observatory seeking to use the Bifrost, prompting a formal warning and conditional activation procedure.
memories.memory_text: I led my group into Heimdall's Observatory and stepped onto the platform, ready to use the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: Heimdall issues a formal warning that he will uphold his oath to protect Asgard, and may deny Bifrost access if their return poses a threat.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Heimdall that he would uphold his oath to protect Asgard and might deny me Bifrost access if our return posed a threat.

grounded_facts: Heimdall inserts his sword into the control panel, initiating the Observatory's apparatus to activate the Bifrost.
memories.memory_text: I saw Heimdall insert his sword into the control panel, activating the Observatory's apparatus to start the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: Heimdall activates the Bifrost by fully inserting his sword into the control panel, causing the Observatory's turret to fire and open the Bifrost at the platform.
memories.memory_text: I saw Heimdall turn his sword in the control panel, then plunge it deeper, and moments later the Observatory's turret fired, sending a blast of rainbow light that opened the Bifrost right before me.

grounded_facts: Volstagg questions why the Bifrost can't remain open, and Heimdall explains it would destroy Jotunheim with them on it.
memories.memory_text: I heard Volstagg ask Heimdall if the Bifrost could stay open, and I listened as Heimdall warned that keeping it open would unleash its full power and destroy Jotunheim with us on it.

grounded_facts: Thor grins and calls on his comrades to follow him into the Bifrost without hesitation.
memories.memory_text: I grinned and called out to my comrades, urging them to follow me into the Bifrost without hesitation.

grounded_facts: A coordinated mission launch in which Thor and his companions prepare and depart from Asgard via the Bifrost to travel to Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I led my companions onto the Bifrost platform, called them forward when they hesitated, and together we stepped into the vortex to begin our journey to Jotunheim.

grounded_facts: Thor and his companions enter the Bifrost vortex and are transported away from the Observatory.
memories.memory_text: I stepped into the Bifrost vortex with my companions, feeling our bodies stretch and pull as we were drawn inside and transported away from the Observatory.

grounded_facts: Thor and his companions arrive on Jotunheim through a rift in the sky created by the Bifrost.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor and his companions arrive on Jotunheim through a rift in the sky created by the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: Thor rescues Volstagg after he slips and dangles over a cliff leading into space.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor rescues Volstagg after he slips and dangles over a cliff leading into space.

grounded_facts: Thor verbally encourages Volstagg while pulling him to safety.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor verbally encourages Volstagg while pulling him to safety.

grounded_facts: Fandral humorously proposes turning back and returning to Asgard for comfort.
memories.memory_text: I heard Fandral joke that we could turn back and return to Asgard for comfort, sharing a mug by the fire.

grounded_facts: Loki suggests waiting to assess the enemy's strengths and weaknesses from a distance.
memories.memory_text: Loki told me we should wait to survey the enemy and gauge their strengths and weaknesses from a distance.

grounded_facts: Despite objections from Loki and others, Thor decides to move forward into enemy territory without further delay.
memories.memory_text: I decided we knew all we needed to know, so I declared it was time to act and moved forward into Jotunheim, leading the group.

grounded_facts: The group travels together across the frozen wasteland of Jotunheim toward the ruins of a destroyed city.
memories.memory_text: I led the group across the frozen wasteland of Jotunheim, trudging forward while my comrades shielded themselves from the harsh wind and cold.

grounded_facts: Thor expresses joy at being on an adventure with his comrades again.
memories.memory_text: I expressed to my comrades how good it felt to be adventuring together again, hoping to lift their spirits despite the freezing conditions.

grounded_facts: Thor suggests singing to lift the group's spirits, but is met with resistance.
memories.memory_text: I suggested we sing to lift our spirits, but the others just groaned in response.

grounded_facts: Sif jokes about Volstagg's singing, contributing to group banter.
memories.memory_text: I heard Sif make a sarcastic remark about Volstagg's singing, and it added to the group's banter.

grounded_facts: The group arrives at the edge of a ruined city on Jotunheim, approaching a temple across a central plaza.
memories.memory_text: I led the group forward toward the temple across the central plaza after we arrived at the edge of the ruined city on Jotunheim, with Loki following reluctantly behind us.

grounded_facts: Thor confronts Laufey, demanding to know how the Frost Giants entered Asgard, escalating tensions between the two parties.
memories.memory_text: I demanded answers from Laufey about how the Frost Giants got into Asgard, and when he called my father's house full of traitors, I knew he was trying to provoke me.

grounded_facts: Laufey mocks Thor as a boy trying to prove himself, undermining his authority and provoking anger.
memories.memory_text: I remember Laufey mocking me, calling me nothing but a boy trying to prove myself a man.

grounded_facts: Loki quietly urges Thor to stop and think, reminding him they are outnumbered.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki tell me to stop and think, that we were outnumbered.

grounded_facts: A massive Frost Giant Brute uses seismic ice manipulation to launch pillars of ice, knocking Hogun back.
memories.memory_text: I saw a massive Frost Giant Brute leap down and slam his fist into the ice, making huge pillars explode right in front of Hogun and send him flying.

grounded_facts: After being mocked as 'little princess', Thor violently retaliates by knocking a Frost Giant across the plaza, triggering open combat.
memories.memory_text: I heard one of the Frost Giants call me 'little princess,' and I immediately struck back, throwing Mjolnir with all my strength to knock him across the plaza.

grounded_facts: Hogun throws a hidden knife to kill Sif's attacker, saving her life during battle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hogun save Sif by throwing a hidden knife into her attacker, killing him instantly.

grounded_facts: A Frost Giant's touch begins necrotizing Volstagg's flesh, causing severe pain and prompting a warning to allies.
memories.memory_text: I saw Volstagg get grabbed by the Frost Giant, and I watched in horror as his skin started to blacken and freeze from the touch—I could hear him shouting in pain and yelling a warning to us.

grounded_facts: Sif uses Volstagg's back as a springboard to drive his blade deeper into a Frost Giant, finishing the kill.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Sif leap off Volstagg's back to drive his blade deeper into a Frost Giant, finishing the kill.

grounded_facts: The Frost Giants activate their cryokinetic abilities, forming ice armor and sword-like appendages, escalating the lethality of the battle.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Frost Giants forming ice bullets and other weapons from their bodies, so I figured they were using their cryokinetic abilities to make the fight more deadly.

grounded_facts: A tense standoff and subsequent battle between Thor's party and the Frost Giants in the Central Plaza, initiated by Thor's demand for answers and escalated by an insult.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Frost Giants surrounding us in the plaza, and when they blocked my path after I stepped toward Laufey, I fought back—taking down several of them while my companions battled at my side.

grounded_facts: Volstagg comforts Fandral while pulling him off the stalagmite, downplaying his injury.
memories.memory_text: I saw Volstagg pull Fandral off the stalagmite after he was impaled, and though Fandral asked about his face, Volstagg just said it was flawless—trying to keep things light even as he carried him away.

grounded_facts: Loki insists that Thor abandon the fight and flee with the group.
memories.memory_text: Loki turned to me and said, 'Thor, we must go!' urging me to flee with the group.

grounded_facts: Sif alerts Thor that there are too many Frost Giants to fight alone.
memories.memory_text: Sif called out that there were too many of them, warning me we couldn't fight them all.

grounded_facts: Volstagg orders the group to run as Frost Giants emerge from the ice.
memories.memory_text: I heard Volstagg shout 'Run!' as the Frost Giants swarmed me from all sides.

grounded_facts: Laufey activates dormant Frost Giant warriors beneath the ice, causing dozens to rise and join the battle.
memories.memory_text: I saw shadowy figures moving beneath the ice and then dozens of Frost Giants rising up to join the fight.

grounded_facts: After being separated from his hammer, Thor summons Mjolnir telekinetically, which strikes down a Frost Giant and flies back to his hand.
memories.memory_text: I called Mjolnir back to me, and I felt it strike down one of the Frost Giants before returning to my hand.

grounded_facts: Thor channels lightning through Mjolnir, creating a massive shockwave that kills surrounding Frost Giants but also fractures the ice beneath the fleeing Asgardians.
memories.memory_text: I channeled lightning through Mjolnir, blasting the Frost Giants around me, but I saw the ice beneath my comrades crack and realized I had put them in danger.

grounded_facts: Frost Giants breathe icy fog that envelops the fleeing Asgardians, immobilizing them above cracks leading to space.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Frost Giants break through the ice and chase us, and when we fled, I felt the mist close in around us — I couldn't see, and I dared not move when I heard the ice crack beneath Hogun's feet, knowing one wrong step could send us all into the void.

grounded_facts: Realizing his friends are in danger, Thor summons winds to lift himself and fly toward his trapped comrades.
memories.memory_text: I realized my blast had cracked the ice beneath my comrades, putting them in danger, so I raised Mjolnir and summoned the winds to lift me toward them.

grounded_facts: Laufey engages Odin in quiet dialogue, then attempts to assassinate him, signaling the breakdown of diplomacy.
memories.memory_text: I saw Laufey rise up and speak with Odin, and when he said they were beyond diplomacy, I knew the peace was broken.

grounded_facts: Thor, seeing the Frost Giants flee, urges Odin to allow a joint pursuit and destruction of the enemy.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Frost Giants fleeing and urged my father to let us finish them together.

grounded_facts: After a brief exchange, Laufey attempts to attack Odin with an ice blade, but Odin repels him with Gungnir, causing the Frost Giants to retreat.
memories.memory_text: I watched Laufey lunge at my father with an ice blade, but Odin struck back with Gungnir and sent them all reeling—I shouted to finish them together.

grounded_facts: Odin cuts off Thor's attempt to continue the fight, asserting his command and ending any further action on Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I was about to press the attack, but my father cut me off with a single command, silencing me instantly.

grounded_facts: A high-tension standoff between the Asgardians and Frost Giants on Jotunheim, interrupted by Odin's arrival and culminating in the retreat of the Frost Giants and extraction of the Asgardians.
Odin arrives via Bifrost on Sleipnir, interrupting the Frost Giants' imminent assault on Thor and his companions, and asserts authority over the situation.
memories.memory_text: I landed with my comrades in the mist, and I saw the Frost Giants—hundreds of them—closing in, and I knew we were as good as dead, but then I heard a deafening roar and saw the Bifrost tear open the sky, and I watched Odin ride through on Sleipnir, stopping right before Laufey, and when he raised his spear, I felt the Bifrost pull me up and away, leaving the Giants behind.

grounded_facts: Odin commands the Bifrost to retrieve the Asgardians, forcibly ending their presence on Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I felt the Bifrost take hold of us as my father summoned it without warning, pulling us away from Jotunheim against my will.

grounded_facts: Fandral is taken to the healing room by Sif, Volstagg, and Hogun after being wounded.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sif, Volstagg, and Hogun carry Fandral away after he was wounded, and I heard someone shout to get him to the healing room.

grounded_facts: Thor calls Odin an old man and a fool, rejecting his authority.
memories.memory_text: I called him an old man and a fool, defying his authority because I believed he was wrong to hold me back.

grounded_facts: Odin condemns Thor for his pride, disobedience, and failure to embody true leadership.
memories.memory_text: I remember Odin calling me a vain, greedy, cruel boy and saying I was a fool to think I was ready, blaming me for disobeying his command and bringing war through my arrogance.

grounded_facts: Odin strips Thor of his powers, titles, and armor, then banishes him through the Bifrost to Midgard.
memories.memory_text: I stood on the Observatory platform as my father used Gungnir to activate the Bifrost behind me, then he ripped the disc from my chest, tore off my cloak, and summoned Mjolnir from my grasp—I felt the lightning strike me as he cast me out.

grounded_facts: A formal and emotional confrontation between Odin and Thor in the Observatory, resulting in Thor's exile.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the Observatory and faced my father Odin, who condemned me for defying his command and declared me unworthy, stripping me of my powers and exiling me from Asgard while I shouted that the old ways were done and he was a fool.

grounded_facts: Odin places a worthiness enchantment on Mjolnir and throws it into the Bifrost after exiling Thor.
memories.memory_text: I saw my father plunge Gungnir into the control panel and summon the Bifrost, and then I felt the lightning from Mjolnir strike me as he cast it away, declaring that only the worthy could wield its power.

grounded_facts: Thor helps Jane to her feet after she falls when he stands up.
memories.memory_text: I helped Jane to her feet after she fell when I stood up, and I could see she was surprised by my strength.

grounded_facts: Thor awakens and immediately searches for his hammer, indicating it is missing.
memories.memory_text: I woke up and immediately started searching the ground for my hammer, muttering 'Hammer...' because I knew it was missing and I needed to find it.

grounded_facts: Jane and Selvig discover and document mysterious rune patterns etched into the sand, likely linked to Thor's arrival.
memories.memory_text: I was groggy when I woke up and saw Jane looking at me with concern; I helped her up after we both fell, and though I didn't notice it at the time, she and Selvig later saw some strange pattern in the sand that must have appeared when I landed.

grounded_facts: Thor appears at the Bifrost landing site on Earth after being transported, initially unconscious and then awakening.
memories.memory_text: I opened my eyes to see a woman named Jane looking at me with concern, and though I was groggy, I got to my feet and helped her up after she fell. I stared at the stars and called out to my father and Heimdall, demanding they open the Bifröst, but there was no response.

grounded_facts: Thor aggressively demands to know what realm he is in, intimidating the group.
memories.memory_text: I demanded to know what world I was on, shouting at the group to answer me, feeling the need to assert control in this unfamiliar place.

grounded_facts: Darcy uses a taser on Thor to stop his aggressive behavior.
Darcy uses a taser to subdue Thor after he becomes aggressive and demands answers.
memories.memory_text: I demanded answers about where I was, and when that woman raised a strange device at me, I told her it could not threaten me—but then she fired it, and I felt my body seize before I fell to the ground, unconscious.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath of Thor's arrival on Earth via the Bifrost, where he is discovered by Jane, Darcy, and Selvig after a car collision.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jane and another man, Selvig, trying to help me, but when he touched me I shoved him away—I didn't trust them yet. A younger woman pointed a strange device at me, and though I didn't recognize it, I felt the shock as it hit me and I lost consciousness.

grounded_facts: After discovering the falsified data, Coulson follows Thor and Selvig as they leave the Security Room.
memories.memory_text: I remember leaving the Security Room with Selvig, and I noticed Coulson following us.

grounded_facts: Coulson tells Selvig to keep Thor away from bars, indicating concern about Thor's behavior.
memories.memory_text: I heard Coulson tell Selvig to keep me away from bars as we were leaving.

grounded_facts: Thor asks where they are going, and Selvig drops his cool demeanor to reveal they are going to get a drink.
memories.memory_text: I asked Selvig where we were going, and he dropped his cool act and told me we were going to get a drink.

grounded_facts: Thor and Selvig depart from the SHIELD desert base in an SUV, marking a transition from official custody to informal movement.
memories.memory_text: I left the SHIELD desert base with Selvig and we got into an SUV together, moving on from their custody.

grounded_facts: Selvig deflects Thor's thanks, clarifying that his actions were motivated solely by concern for Jane, not loyalty to Thor.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Selvig deflects Thor's thanks, clarifying that his actions were motivated solely by concern for Jane, not loyalty to Thor.

grounded_facts: Selvig questions Thor's motives regarding Jane, expressing protective concern and setting a condition for Thor's continued presence.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Selvig questions Thor's motives regarding Jane, expressing protective concern and setting a condition for Thor's continued presence.

grounded_facts: Thor acknowledges that he has been wrong about many things, including his understanding of Jane and his role, marking a personal turning point.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor acknowledges that he has been wrong about many things, including his understanding of Jane and his role, marking a personal turning point.

grounded_facts: A private conversation between Thor and Selvig in a bar, where personal revelations and emotional honesty occur.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A private conversation between Thor and Selvig in a bar, where personal revelations and emotional honesty occur.

grounded_facts: The drunk townie mocks Thor's association with Jane and uses a derogatory term, attempting to provoke a fight.
memories.memory_text: I remember the drunk townie approaching me, clearly looking for a fight, and calling me 'princess' after mocking my connection to Jane.

grounded_facts: An aggressive encounter initiated by a drunk townie who recognizes Thor from earlier and provokes him, leading to physical intervention by Selvig.
memories.memory_text: I remember that An aggressive encounter initiated by a drunk townie who recognizes Thor from earlier and provokes him, leading to physical intervention by Selvig.

grounded_facts: Selvig physically intervenes in a confrontation between Thor and a hostile townie by head-butting the aggressor unconscious, preventing violence against Thor.
memories.memory_text: I saw Selvig step in between me and the aggressor, and then he head-butted the man, knocking him out to protect me.

grounded_facts: After knocking out the drunk townie, Selvig casually offers Thor another drink, signaling approval and solidarity.
memories.memory_text: After knocking the townie out, Selvig turned to me and casually offered me another drink, as if nothing had happened.

grounded_facts: An impromptu celebration on Main Street where Thor and Selvig sing and dance together.
memories.memory_text: I remember that An impromptu celebration on Main Street where Thor and Selvig sing and dance together.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor raises his hand for a celebratory high-five/slap at the end of their song, which Selvig fails to complete due to collapsing.

grounded_facts: Selvig loses balance during a dance routine and collapses, becoming unresponsive.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Selvig loses balance during a dance routine and collapses, becoming unresponsive.

grounded_facts: After Selvig collapses, Thor takes him on his shoulder and walks toward Jane's trailer.
memories.memory_text: I saw Selvig collapse, so I lifted him onto my shoulder and carried him toward Jane's trailer to keep him safe.

grounded_facts: An off-screen event where Thor and Selvig drank alcohol and engaged in physical combat, resulting in Selvig becoming unconscious.
memories.memory_text: I remember drinking and fighting with Selvig—he made his ancestors proud.

grounded_facts: Upon waking briefly, Selvig expresses disbelief but then concedes that Thor should be the God of Thunder.
memories.memory_text: I heard Selvig wake up and say he didn't believe I was the God of Thunder, but then he added that I ought to be, which gave me hope that he was starting to accept me.

grounded_facts: Thor brings Selvig, who is unconscious, to Jane's trailer and enters without invitation.
memories.memory_text: I carried Selvig into Jane's trailer, bumped his head on the doorway, set him down on the bed, and patted his cheek to let him know I cared.

grounded_facts: Thor gently pats Selvig on the cheek and covers him with a blanket after he falls asleep.
memories.memory_text: After he drifted off, I gently patted him on the cheek and pulled a blanket over him to keep him warm, making sure he was comfortable.

grounded_facts: Jane asks Thor to go outside, likely to escape the embarrassment of her messy trailer.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jane ask me if we could go outside, probably because she wanted to get out of her messy trailer and away from the awkwardness.

grounded_facts: After Thor comments on her trailer, Jane begins cleaning and expresses discomfort about its state and lack of visitors.
memories.memory_text: I saw Jane start cleaning up her trailer and looking uneasy after I commented on it, like she was embarrassed by the mess and never having people over.

grounded_facts: A private nighttime meeting on the roof of Smith Motors where Jane and Thor reconnect, share personal reflections, and discuss cosmic science.
memories.memory_text: I stepped onto the roof of Smith Motors at night and helped Jane up the ladder; we sat under the stars with her telescope and blankets, and I listened as she told me how she comes up there to think, to work on her science, or to get away from Darcy.

grounded_facts: Thor acknowledges that he has not been as grateful as he should have been for Jane's kindness.
memories.memory_text: I told Jane that she's been very kind to me, and I admitted that I haven't been as grateful as I should have been.

grounded_facts: Thor gives Jane back her notebook, which he managed to retrieve during his journey.
memories.memory_text: I reached into my pocket and gave Jane back her notebook, which I had kept safe during my journey, and I saw how surprised and thankful she was to have it again.

grounded_facts: Jane voices her fear that SHIELD will prevent her research from being published or recognized.
memories.memory_text: I remember Jane telling me that she feared SHIELD would never let her research see the light of day.

grounded_facts: Thor urges Jane to continue her scientific work, affirming its importance and proximity to a major breakthrough.
memories.memory_text: I urged Jane to finish what she started, telling her she was nearly there and just needed someone to show her how close she really was.

grounded_facts: Thor uses Jane's notebook to draw the branches of Yggdrasil, explaining the connection between the Nine Realms and how they appear in human observations.
memories.memory_text: I used Jane's notebook to draw the branches of Yggdrasil, explaining how her world is one of the Nine Realms connected by the Worlds Tree, and how she sees them every day through the Hubble Telescope without realizing it.

grounded_facts: Jane shows unconscious physical affection toward Thor while sleeping, moving closer and nuzzling against him.
memories.memory_text: I felt Jane roll closer to me and nuzzle against me while she was asleep.

grounded_facts: Hogun makes the decision to leave Asgard and find Thor, initiating the group's plan to defy Loki's rule.
memories.memory_text: I decided we had to leave Asgard and find Thor, so I began gathering the healing stones to prepare for the journey, knowing this was our first step in defying Loki's rule.

grounded_facts: Thor assists Jane in standing up after they wake up together on the roof.
memories.memory_text: I stood up and offered my hand to Jane, helping her to her feet after we woke up together on the roof.

grounded_facts: Thor assists Jane in descending from a ladder, indicating care and physical proximity.
memories.memory_text: I helped Jane down from the ladder, making sure she was safe as we prepared to enter Smith Motors.

grounded_facts: Selvig sees Thor and Jane together and reacts with a need for coffee, implying discomfort or realization.
memories.memory_text: I saw Selvig notice me and Jane together, and he looked like he was taken aback, as if something hit him all at once.

grounded_facts: Selvig makes a comment about needing coffee after seeing Thor and Jane together, indirectly acknowledging their closeness.
memories.memory_text: I heard Selvig say he needed coffee after seeing me and Jane, which felt like his way of acknowledging how close we were without saying it outright.

grounded_facts: Thor, Jane, and Selvig enter the interior of Smith Motors.
memories.memory_text: I entered the interior of Smith Motors with Jane and Selvig.

grounded_facts: Darcy verbally thanks Thor for serving the food.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Darcy verbally thanks Thor for serving the food.

grounded_facts: Thor delivers plates of food to Darcy and Selvig, who acknowledge him politely.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor delivers plates of food to Darcy and Selvig, who acknowledge him politely.

grounded_facts: A casual breakfast shared by Jane, Thor, Darcy, and Selvig in the lab, evoking a familial dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A casual breakfast shared by Jane, Thor, Darcy, and Selvig in the lab, evoking a familial dynamic.

grounded_facts: Jane cooks eggs on a hotplate and Thor serves the food to Darcy and Selvig, followed by joining them for breakfast.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Jane cooks eggs on a hotplate and Thor serves the food to Darcy and Selvig, followed by joining them for breakfast.

grounded_facts: The group finishes eating breakfast at Smith Motors lab.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group finishes eating breakfast at Smith Motors lab.

grounded_facts: Thor asks Darcy if he can have the mug; she agrees.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor asks Darcy if he can have the mug; she agrees.

grounded_facts: Thor asks for and receives permission to take a mug, then leaves with it.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Thor asks for and receives permission to take a mug, then leaves with it.

grounded_facts: Isabela prepares her diner for the day's business, sweeping the porch and setting up.
memories.memory_text: I saw Isabela preparing her diner for the day, sweeping the porch as I approached.

grounded_facts: Thor offers a replacement mug and asks for forgiveness for breaking the previous one.
Thor gives Isabela a new mug to replace the one he previously broke, as an apology gesture.
memories.memory_text: I offered Isabela a new mug to replace the one I broke and asked her to forgive my behavior.

grounded_facts: Isabela accepts Thor's apology and thanks him, indicating reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I apologized to Isabela for my behavior and offered her a replacement mug, and she accepted it with a smile and said, 'Okay. Thank you,' which I took as her forgiving me.

grounded_facts: Isabela accepts Thor's apology and the replacement mug, signaling a shift in her attitude toward him.
memories.memory_text: I saw her take the mug, look at it, and then smile at me before saying 'Okay. Thank you,' and in that moment, I could tell she was no longer upset with me.

grounded_facts: Thor asks for permission to return for more coffee, signaling interest in continued interaction.
memories.memory_text: I asked Isabela if I could come back for more of her coffee, and she said, 'Any time,' which made me feel welcome to return.

grounded_facts: Sif and the Warriors Three arrive at the lab and reunite with Thor and his Earth companions after a long absence.
memories.memory_text: I happily raced over to greet Sif and the Warriors Three when they arrived at the lab, reuniting with my comrades after a long time apart.

grounded_facts: Fandral states their purpose is to bring Thor back to Asgard.
memories.memory_text: Fandral told me, 'We're here to take you home,' making it clear they came to bring me back to Asgard.

grounded_facts: Sif and the Warriors Three arrive on Earth with the purpose of bringing Thor back to Asgard.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Sif and the Warriors Three came all the way to Earth with the purpose of bringing me back to Asgard, though I'm not entirely certain why it's so urgent.

grounded_facts: Sif corrects Thor's belief by revealing that Odin is still alive.
memories.memory_text: I saw Sif correct my belief when she told me, 'Thor... your father still lives.'

grounded_facts: Thor discovers that his father Odin is still alive, contradicting his belief that Odin died because of him.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sif that my father Odin is still alive, which contradicted what I believed—that he had died because of me—and I remember how I reacted in that moment.

grounded_facts: Thor and the group notice the Bifrost storm forming in the distance, indicating an imminent arrival.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Bifrost storm forming in the distance with the others, and I knew someone was about to arrive.

grounded_facts: Sif tells Thor that his most effective role is to get the mortals to safety and leave the fighting to the Asgardians.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Sif that my most effective role was to get the mortals to safety and leave the fighting to the Asgardians.

grounded_facts: The Asgardians gather at Smith Motors to prepare for battle against the Destroyer, while townspeople observe the distant firefight.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Asgardians gather at Smith Motors to prepare for battle while the townspeople remained unaware of the danger, and I turned my attention to protecting them.

grounded_facts: Thor decides to prioritize saving the townspeople instead of joining the battle, committing to clear the streets with Jane, Selvig, and Darcy.
Thor directs Jane, Selvig, and Darcy to help him evacuate the townspeople from the streets to protect them from the battle.
memories.memory_text: I decided to commit myself to saving the townspeople and directed Jane, Selvig, and Darcy to help me clear the streets so none of them would die that day.

grounded_facts: Thor, Jane, and Selvig begin clearing the streets by loading townsfolk into cars and moving others indoors.
memories.memory_text: I helped Jane and Selvig clear the streets by loading townsfolk into cars and moving others indoors to keep them safe.

grounded_facts: Thor tells Jane that his friends are fighting bravely but cannot hold back the Destroyer for much longer.
memories.memory_text: I told Jane that my friends are fighting bravely but won't be able to hold the Destroyer back much longer.

grounded_facts: A coordinated combat effort by the Warriors Three and Sif to stop the Destroyer from advancing through the town.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Warriors Three and Sif launch a coordinated attack on the Destroyer, but despite their best efforts, the creature shrugged off their assault and blasted them apart.

grounded_facts: Thor helps Jane regain her footing after the explosion.
memories.memory_text: I helped Jane to her feet after the explosion, making sure she was okay before we both noticed Selvig lying in the debris.

grounded_facts: An explosion caused by the Destroyer damages the storefront, injuring Thor, Jane, and Selvig, and initiating a rescue and healing effort.
memories.memory_text: I saw the storefront explode and felt the blast throw me to the ground; I got up quickly and helped Jane to her feet, then we both rushed to Selvig’s side when I saw him impaled and bleeding badly.

grounded_facts: Selvig, injured and in shock, urges Jane to abandon him to save herself.
memories.memory_text: I heard Selvig tell Jane to leave him behind while he was injured and in shock.

grounded_facts: Thor discovers a single unbroken healing stone among crushed ones in Hogun's pouch, enabling its use for healing.
memories.memory_text: I spotted Hogun's pouch in the street, grabbed it, and found all the healing stones crushed—until I saw one still intact; I crushed it in my hand and held it over the iron in Selvig, hoping it would work.

grounded_facts: Thor crushes the intact healing stone, releasing glowing powder that dissolves the iron impaling Selvig and fully heals his wound.
memories.memory_text: I crushed the intact healing stone and released glowing powder that dissolved the iron in Selvig and completely healed his wound.

grounded_facts: After being healed, Selvig expresses growing admiration for Thor.
memories.memory_text: I saw Selvig express that he was really starting to like me after I healed him.

grounded_facts: After healing Selvig, Thor departs without notice, leaving Jane and Selvig behind.
memories.memory_text: I healed Selvig and then saw my other friends still wounded down the street, so I left to help them without saying anything to Jane or Selvig.

grounded_facts: Thor finds Sif injured on the ground and pulls her behind a burning vehicle, urging her to escape while she still can.
memories.memory_text: I reached Sif where she lay injured and pulled her behind a burning vehicle, urging her to escape while she still could because I knew she couldn't help anyone in that state.

grounded_facts: Thor gently takes Sif's shield from her, symbolically preventing her from fighting and reinforcing her need to survive.
memories.memory_text: I gently took her shield from her, knowing it was the only way to stop her from fighting and make her accept that she needed to survive.

grounded_facts: Thor convinces Sif to abandon her desire for a warrior's death and instead live to tell the story.
memories.memory_text: I told Sif she couldn't help her allies now and that her duty was to survive, and when she insisted on dying a warrior's death, I made her see that she should live to tell those stories herself—and at last, she agreed.

grounded_facts: Thor discovers Volstagg unconscious and instructs Hogun and Fandral to move him to safety, warning that he will die otherwise.
memories.memory_text: I spotted Volstagg lying unconscious and barely breathing, so I tried to pull him to safety, but I couldn't move him alone—I had to wake Hogun and Fandral and urgently told them to get him out of there.

grounded_facts: Thor orders Hogun and Fandral to evacuate Volstagg, emphasizing that failure means death.
memories.memory_text: I ordered Hogun and Fandral to move Volstagg, making it clear that if they didn't act, he would die.

grounded_facts: Thor tells Hogun and Fandral he has a plan, which implicitly involves sacrificing himself to distract the Destroyer.
memories.memory_text: I told Hogun and Fandral not to worry because I had a plan, though I didn't tell them I meant to face the Destroyer alone.

grounded_facts: A chaotic retreat unfolds as Thor coordinates the evacuation of injured Asgardians from the battlefield.
memories.memory_text: I saw the others retreating, dragging their fallen friend away from the battlefield while I stayed behind to face the Destroyer.

grounded_facts: Thor pleads with the Destroyer to take his life instead of harming the innocent humans.
memories.memory_text: I pleaded with the Destroyer, telling it that if I had wronged my brother and caused this, I was sorry—but those people were innocent and didn't deserve to suffer.

grounded_facts: After ensuring his allies are gone, Thor tosses aside Sif's shield and walks defenselessly toward the Destroyer, offering his life.
memories.memory_text: After making sure my allies were gone, I tossed aside Sif's shield and walked defenselessly toward the Destroyer, arms open, offering my life to protect the innocent.

grounded_facts: The Destroyer hesitates, then strikes Thor with its arm, breaking his bones and knocking him unconscious.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Destroyer hesitating for a moment before striking me with its arm—I felt my bones break as I was thrown through the air, and then everything went black.

grounded_facts: Thor confronts the Destroyer alone, offering his life to spare the innocent humans.
memories.memory_text: After sending the others to safety, I turned to the Destroyer, tossed aside Sif's shield, walked toward it defenseless, and offered my life so the innocent humans would be spared.

grounded_facts: Thor dies as his last breath leaves his body.
memories.memory_text: I felt my last breath leave my body as my eyes closed.

grounded_facts: Thor returns in full battle armor, reclaiming his identity as the God of Thunder and immediately engaging the Destroyer.
memories.memory_text: I returned in my full battle armor, feeling Mjolnir's power in my hand once more, and struck the Destroyer with lightning, reclaiming who I truly am.

grounded_facts: Thor destroys the Destroyer by forcing its own energy blast back into its body and jamming Mjolnir into its faceplate, causing a fatal internal explosion.
memories.memory_text: I remember striking the Destroyer with lightning, then using Mjolnir to overpower its energy blast and force it back into the machine; I jammed my hammer into its faceplate, causing a massive internal explosion that I felt shake the ground beneath me.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Thor and the Destroyer on Main Street, involving lightning, explosions, and aerial combat.
memories.memory_text: I dove straight at the Destroyer, driving Mjolnir into its energy blast and forcing it back, smashing it into the ground until the fire within it died, then walked away from its lifeless shell.

grounded_facts: The immediate aftermath of the battle, where allies regroup and Coulson confronts Thor.
memories.memory_text: After the battle, I saw my allies rise to stand beside me, but then Coulson approached, battered but determined, as if he meant to confront me.

grounded_facts: Coulson directly challenges Thor's honesty about his identity or actions.
Coulson approaches Thor (Donald) and accuses him of dishonesty regarding his true identity or capabilities.
memories.memory_text: I remember Coulson approaching me and calling me Donald—he said I hadn't been completely honest with him about who I really am or what I can do.

grounded_facts: A group including Thor, Jane, Darcy, Selvig, Asgardians, Coulson, and SHIELD agents assemble at the Earth-side Bifrost site in the desert.
memories.memory_text: I was with Jane, Darcy, Selvig, and the others at the desert Bifrost site, standing alongside my Asgardian companions and SHIELD agents as we prepared for what came next.

grounded_facts: Darcy asks how Volstagg can speak English, leading to his humorous correction that they are all speaking Asgardian.
memories.memory_text: I heard Darcy ask Volstagg how he could speak English, and then I heard him chuckle and tell her she was actually speaking Asgardian, which made me realize how easy it is for humans to misunderstand our shared tongue.

grounded_facts: Thor calls out to Heimdall to open the Bifrost from Earth's desert landing site.
memories.memory_text: I called up to the sky and shouted to Heimdall to open the Bifrost from the desert site on Earth.

grounded_facts: Thor shares his fear that Heimdall cannot reopen the Bifrost, signaling despair.
memories.memory_text: I shared my fear with the others, telling them I believe Heimdall cannot reopen the Bifrost, and in that moment, I felt despair settle in.

grounded_facts: Thor expresses concern that Heimdall cannot reopen the Bifrost, implying a belief that the worst has happened.
memories.memory_text: I looked to the others with concern and said, 'He would open it if he could. I fear the worst,' because I believe Heimdall can't reopen the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: Fandral initiates romantic interest in Darcy by complimenting Earth women, specifically her.
Fandral directs a charming question at Darcy, asking if all Earth women are as fair as she is.
memories.memory_text: I saw Fandral turn on his charm and ask Darcy if all Earth women were as fair as she was, clearly showing his romantic interest in her.

grounded_facts: Thor shouts to Heimdall in a final attempt to reestablish contact or reopen the Bifrost.
Thor shouts up to the sky, calling Heimdall's name in a desperate attempt to reach him.
memories.memory_text: I shouted up to the sky, calling out 'Heimdall!' in one final desperate attempt to reach him and reopen the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: Heimdall uses all his strength to shatter the ice imprisoning him, freeing himself at great physical cost.
memories.memory_text: I saw Heimdall shatter free from the ice with a tremendous effort, breaking loose after hearing my call.

grounded_facts: After breaking free, Heimdall drags himself into the Observatory despite severe weakness.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Heimdall must have dragged himself into the Observatory despite being weakened and near death, though I didn't see it directly.

grounded_facts: Fandral offers a light-hearted apology to Darcy for the sudden arrival of the Bifrost.
memories.memory_text: I saw Fandral turn to Darcy and say, 'Sorry, my love. These things happen,' before he joined the others at their side.

grounded_facts: Thor declares his alliance with Coulson and SHIELD, conditional on the return of Jane Foster's equipment.
Thor tells Coulson they fight for the same cause and offers his alliance, conditional on the return of Jane's equipment.
memories.memory_text: I turned to Coulson and declared that we fight for the same cause—the protection of this world—and offered my alliance, on the condition that he returns the items taken from Jane Foster.

grounded_facts: After Jane gives him a look, Coulson quickly clarifies that SHIELD borrowed, not stole, her equipment and promises its return and research sponsorship.
Coulson clarifies that SHIELD borrowed, not stole, Jane Foster's equipment and offers full sponsorship for her research.
memories.memory_text: After Jane gave Coulson a look, I heard him clarify that SHIELD had only borrowed her equipment and promised to return it, offering full sponsorship for her research.

grounded_facts: Thor shares an emotional farewell with Jane Foster, affirming their bond before departing through the Bifrost.
Thor takes Jane's hand and later embraces her, declaring that she is part of his fate, before kissing her passionately.
memories.memory_text: I took Jane's hand and kissed it, feeling her fear as she looked at me, and I told her that whatever fate lies before me, she is part of it—I held her close and kissed her passionately, knowing our bond runs deep.

grounded_facts: The Bifrost suddenly explodes down from the sky, marking the arrival of reinforcements or a means of departure for the Asgardians.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Bifrost explode down from the sky, and I grinned because I knew it meant we could finally leave; I leapt into it with the other Asgardians.

grounded_facts: Thor and the Asgardians leave Earth by leaping into the Bifrost.
memories.memory_text: I leapt into the Bifrost with the Asgardians, leaving Earth behind as the portal opened before us.

grounded_facts: The Asgardians discover Heimdall unconscious at his post.
memories.memory_text: I saw Heimdall lying unconscious when we arrived at the observatory.

grounded_facts: Thor assumes leadership upon arrival at Heimdall's Observatory, issuing orders to the group.
Thor directs the Asgardians to take Heimdall to the healing room while separating from the group to deal with his brother.
memories.memory_text: I took command right away and told the others to get Heimdall to the healing room while I went after my brother.

grounded_facts: Thor is traveling rapidly over the Rainbow Bridge, heading towards the palace.
memories.memory_text: I am speeding across the Rainbow Bridge, riding the winds as I advance toward the palace.

grounded_facts: Thor reaches the entrance of Odin's Palace after racing there.
memories.memory_text: I raced through the entrance to the palace and arrived at Odin's Palace.

grounded_facts: Loki uses Gungnir to kill Laufey as he was about to kill Odin, marking a decisive intervention and assertion of loyalty to his adoptive father.
memories.memory_text: I saw Loki blast Laufey from behind with Gungnir and kill him, then take out another Frost Giant before he could reach him.

grounded_facts: Frigga silently eliminates the remaining threatening Frost Giant from behind, demonstrating her combat capability and protecting Loki.
memories.memory_text: I saw Frigga silently kill the last attacking Frost Giant from behind and then embrace Loki, showing her strength and care.

grounded_facts: Frigga expresses pride and maternal love for Loki after his actions in defense of Asgard.
memories.memory_text: I saw Frigga embrace Loki and look at him with pride and respect after he defended Asgard.

grounded_facts: Loki vows to end the Jotun threat permanently, signaling a shift in his personal mission and public role.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki vow to end the Jotun threat forever, swearing it to his mother in a moment of fierce determination.

grounded_facts: A confrontation in Odin's chambers where Laufey attempts to kill the defenseless Odin, leading to a violent intervention by Loki and Frigga.
memories.memory_text: I saw Laufey standing over my sleeping father, threatening to kill him, and then Loki and Frigga burst in to stop the attack.

grounded_facts: Frigga joyfully embraces Thor upon his return, showing maternal warmth.
memories.memory_text: I saw my mother Frigga beam with joy when she saw me, and she hugged me tightly, though I could feel my focus shifting to Loki even as she held me.

grounded_facts: Thor confronts Loki about sending the Destroyer to kill him and their friends, exposing past treachery.
memories.memory_text: I confronted Loki directly, demanding he tell the truth about sending the Destroyer to kill me and our friends, because I knew he was responsible.

grounded_facts: Loki denies responsibility by claiming the Destroyer was acting on Odin's last command.
memories.memory_text: I was told that the Destroyer was only acting on Odin's last command, but I didn't believe it came from my father.

grounded_facts: Loki fires Gungnir at Thor point-blank, violently rejecting reconciliation and initiating fraternal conflict.
memories.memory_text: I saw Loki raise Gungnir and fire it at me point-blank — I didn't expect it, and the impact sent me crashing through the wall.

grounded_facts: Thor is thrown through a wall in the corridor of Odin's palace due to a powerful blast.
memories.memory_text: I was thrown through a wall in the corridor of Odin's palace by a powerful blast.

grounded_facts: Thor falls from the palace and crashes into the reflecting pools below.
memories.memory_text: I fell from the palace and crashed into the reflecting pools below.

grounded_facts: Thor wakes up and sees the Observatory firing Bifrost energy into space, recognizing its target.
memories.memory_text: I woke up to the sound of the Bifrost, stood up, and saw the Observatory firing energy into space; when I looked toward its target, I realized it was aimed at Jotunheim.

grounded_facts: Thor lands at the entrance of the Observatory after soaring above the Rainbow Bridge, indicating his arrival with purpose.
memories.memory_text: I soared above the Rainbow Bridge, riding the winds and Bifrost energy, then landed before the Observatory's huge doorway to make my arrival known.

grounded_facts: Loki declares his intention to destroy the Frost Giants, framing it as completing what Odin could not, thereby revealing his true motives and ideological break from Thor.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki say he intended to destroy the Frost Giants to finish what Odin could not, and that he believed Father would approve when he awoke.

grounded_facts: Loki denies any familial bond, severing the emotional connection between the brothers.
Loki explicitly rejects his familial bond with Thor, marking a definitive severance of their relationship.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Loki that he is not my brother and never was, severing our bond outright.

grounded_facts: A direct confrontation between Thor and Loki at the observatory, where Loki has activated the Bifrost as a weapon against Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I entered the observatory and saw the Bifrost blasting toward Jotunheim, so I rushed to stop it, but Loki attacked me with Gungnir, throwing me back and knocking me down before I could reach the controls.

grounded_facts: Loki strikes Thor across the face with Gungnir and later immobilizes him with energy blasts, asserting dominance and provoking combat.
memories.memory_text: I felt the impact when Loki struck me across the face with Gungnir, and then I was blasted and hung suspended in the air, unable to move.

grounded_facts: Loki uses Thor's attachment to Jane Foster to provoke him emotionally.
Loki mocks Thor's softness and threatens to visit and likely harm Jane Foster, provoking Thor into combat.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki mock me for becoming soft because of my time on Earth, and when he threatened to visit Jane, I knew he meant to harm her.

grounded_facts: Provoked by Loki's threat, Thor abandons restraint and rushes into battle, marking the start of mutual physical conflict.
memories.memory_text: I let go of restraint and rushed at Loki, colliding with him as we both attacked — I started the fight.

grounded_facts: Thor verbally rejects combat, denying Loki the validation of equal battle.
Despite being attacked, Thor refuses to engage Loki in combat, asserting a moral stance against fratricidal violence.
memories.memory_text: I told Loki I would not fight him, and even as he attacked, I refused to engage because I stand against violence between brothers.

grounded_facts: Loki uses Gungnir to knock Mjolnir from Thor's hand, disarming him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Loki use Gungnir to strike me and knock Mjolnir from my hand, leaving me defenseless.

grounded_facts: Thor loses control of Mjolnir, which is flung into the Bifrost and disappears toward Jotunheim.
memories.memory_text: I watched as Mjolnir flew into the Bifrost and disappeared toward Jotunheim while I was being pulled in by the vortex.

grounded_facts: Loki mocks Thor's concern for the Jotuns, challenging his loyalty and intent.
memories.memory_text: Loki told me, 'If you care so much for the Jotuns, then die with them,' mocking my concern for them and questioning my loyalty.

grounded_facts: Thor is nearly sucked into the Bifrost vortex, physically stretched by its force.
memories.memory_text: I was nearly sucked into the Bifrost vortex, feeling every part of my body stretched by its force as I struggled to resist.

grounded_facts: Despite the Bifrost's force, Thor successfully calls Mjolnir back to his hand, reclaiming it.
memories.memory_text: I reached out through the storm, straining to call Mjolnir back to me, and despite the Bifrost's pull, I felt it return to my hand.

grounded_facts: A violent confrontation between Thor and Loki within Heimdall's Observatory, involving the Bifrost and Mjolnir.
memories.memory_text: I was in a fierce battle with Loki at Heimdall's Observatory, where we fought with the Bifrost and my hammer Mjolnir was knocked from my hand.

grounded_facts: After reclaiming Mjolnir, Thor flies toward Loki to attack, evading a blast.
memories.memory_text: After reclaiming Mjolnir, I took to the air and sped toward Loki, evading his blast as I moved in to strike.

grounded_facts: After reclaiming Mjolnir, Thor uses it to escape the Bifrost's pull and launches toward Loki.
memories.memory_text: I used Mjolnir to pull myself free from the vortex, then flew toward Loki to launch my attack.

grounded_facts: Loki mocks Thor for being unable to stop the Bifrost despite his strength, highlighting his perceived superiority.
memories.memory_text: I heard Loki mock me, saying, 'Look at you, the Mighty Thor. With all your strength, what good does it do you now?' as I stood there unable to stop the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: Thor smashes Mjolnir into the Rainbow Bridge repeatedly, causing it to crack and eventually shatter, stopping the Bifrost from fully activating and sending destructive energy outward.
memories.memory_text: I struck the Rainbow Bridge with Mjolnir again and again, feeling the cracks spread beneath my blows, until I shattered it completely with one final strike, stopping the Bifrost from destroying everything.

grounded_facts: A confrontation at Heimdall's Observatory where Loki attempts to use the Bifrost to attack Jotunheim, leading to Thor's intervention and the ultimate destruction of the Rainbow Bridge.
memories.memory_text: I fought Loki at the Observatory when he tried to use the Bifrost to attack Jotunheim, and though he stabbed me and mocked my power, I realized I could stop the surge by destroying the Rainbow Bridge.

grounded_facts: Thor chooses not to kill Loki when he is pinned under Mjolnir, but later fails to save him when Loki lets go of Gungnir.
memories.memory_text: I chose not to kill Loki when I had him pinned under Mjolnir, and later I held onto Gungnir trying to save him, but I couldn't stop him from letting go and falling into the Bifrost.

grounded_facts: After being caught in the Bifrost surge with Thor, Loki sees Odin on the broken bridge. Upon seeing only disappointment in Odin's face, he voluntarily releases Gungnir and falls into the energy stream.
memories.memory_text: I saw Loki searching Odin's face as we dangled from Gungnir, and when he saw only disappointment, he let go and fell into the Bifrost stream.

grounded_facts: Odin, awakened from the Odinsleep, appears on the broken edge of the Rainbow Bridge and catches Thor's leg, pulling him to safety after the destruction of the Bifrost.
memories.memory_text: I felt a powerful hand catch my leg mid-fall, and I looked up to see Odin had awakened and pulled me to safety.

grounded_facts: A banquet held in Odin's palace where Asgardians gather to celebrate, though undercurrents of grief and loss persist.
memories.memory_text: I was at a banquet in my father's palace, surrounded by Asgardians celebrating, though I could feel the weight of grief beneath the surface.

grounded_facts: Hogun makes a dry remark about Volstagg's big stomach and Fandral's big mouth, prompting laughter and lightening the mood momentarily.
Hogun points at Volstagg and says 'Big stomach', then at Fandral and says 'Big mouth', humorously critiquing their personalities.
memories.memory_text: I saw Hogun point at Volstagg and say 'Big stomach', then at Fandral and say 'Big mouth'—his dry remark made everyone laugh and briefly eased the tension between them.

grounded_facts: A private nighttime exchange between Odin and Thor on the palace balcony, focusing on legacy, kingship, and paternal approval.
memories.memory_text: I stood alone on the palace balcony at night, lost in thought, when I felt my father Odin approach behind me.

grounded_facts: Thor expresses recognition of his past shortcomings and a desire to grow into a worthy king.
Thor admits he has much to learn and hopes to one day make Odin proud.
memories.memory_text: I told my father that I recognize my past shortcomings, that I have much to learn, and I hope that one day I can make him proud.

grounded_facts: Odin tells Thor that he is already proud of him, providing emotional closure and validation.
Odin tells Thor he is already proud of him, reinforcing a positive father-son bond.
memories.memory_text: I was told by my father Odin that I've already made him proud, and in those words I felt his validation and love as a son accepted.

grounded_facts: Heimdall stands on the broken Rainbow Bridge, observing Earth from Asgard; Thor joins him in this moment of vigil.
memories.memory_text: I walked to the edge of the broken Rainbow Bridge where Heimdall stood, and I stared out into the void alongside him.

grounded_facts: Thor questions Heimdall about Jane's whereabouts and condition, relying on Heimdall's enhanced sight.
Thor asks Heimdall if he can see Jane and how she is, showing concern for her well-being from afar.
memories.memory_text: I asked Heimdall if he could see Jane and how she was, because I needed to know she was safe.

grounded_facts: Selvig attempts to explain the concept of an Einstein-Rosen Bridge, which Jane simplifies as a wormhole for Darcy's understanding.
memories.memory_text: I heard Selvig explaining the Einstein-Rosen Bridge as a theoretical connection in space-time, and I simplified it by saying 'a wormhole' so Darcy could understand.

grounded_facts: Jane identifies star patterns in the Bifrost anomaly that do not match Earth's sky, suggesting extraterrestrial origin or interdimensional connection.
memories.memory_text: I was analyzing the Bifrost anomaly on the monitor and noticed the star patterns didn't match anything in Earth's sky—I got the printout and spread out my star chart to compare, and it was so exciting because it meant we were seeing something truly beyond our world.

grounded_facts: An all-night research session in which Jane, Darcy, and Selvig analyze data from the Bifrost event, leading to major scientific and personal revelations.
memories.memory_text: I remember how we spent the entire night analyzing the Bifrost data with Darcy and Selvig, fueled by caffeine and excitement, and when we finally examined that photo, I was amazed by what we saw.

grounded_facts: Darcy notices a distinct humanoid shape within the Bifrost funnel cloud, indicating a possible physical entity transported or present during the event.
memories.memory_text: I was in the lab when Darcy called me over to look at a frame-grab from the Bifrost footage, and when I saw it, I noticed a distinct humanoid shape in the cloud—something that made me realize this wasn't just a natural phenomenon.

grounded_facts: Upon seeing the human figure in the Bifrost image, Jane abruptly leaves the lab, implying a personal connection to the figure.
memories.memory_text: I was examining the Bifrost image with Selvig when I saw the figure inside the funnel cloud—I recognized it immediately and knew I had to leave right away.

grounded_facts: A procedural checkpoint at the hospital ER where the admissions nurse verifies familial relationship before granting visitation rights.
memories.memory_text: I remember the nurse telling me that only relatives can visit patients, which is why I had to think fast.

grounded_facts: Jane falsely claims to be the patient's wife in order to gain visitation access, improvising a justification when challenged by the nurse.
Jane lies to the nurse by claiming she is the patient's wife, manipulating the situation to bypass visitation rules.
memories.memory_text: I told the nurse I was his wife when she questioned me, even though it wasn't true, because I needed to see him and I knew they wouldn't let me in otherwise.

grounded_facts: Jane, Selvig, and Darcy arrive at Thor's hospital room after walking through the corridor.
memories.memory_text: I walked down the hospital corridor with Selvig and Darcy, passing the wreckage from the ER that Thor had destroyed the night before, and then I entered Thor's hospital room.

grounded_facts: Jane, Selvig, and Darcy enter Jane's SUV in the hospital parking lot.
memories.memory_text: I quickly climbed into my SUV with Selvig and Darcy in the hospital parking lot.

grounded_facts: Jane announces the loss of her most important evidence, setting urgency.
memories.memory_text: I just lost my most important piece of evidence, and that made everything feel urgent.

grounded_facts: Selvig expresses concern about finding Thor due to his unexplained actions.
memories.memory_text: I was told that finding Thor might not be the best idea because of what he did in there.

grounded_facts: Jane decides to locate Thor to obtain answers about the mysterious object.
memories.memory_text: I decided we have to find Thor because I want to know what that thing was, and he may have the answers.

grounded_facts: Darcy voices uncertainty about the plan with 'Oo-kay.'
memories.memory_text: I heard Darcy say 'Oo-kay' when I brought up the plan, and I could tell she was uncertain.

memories.memory_text: I was reversing the SUV to start the search when I suddenly collided with Thor—he reappeared out of nowhere, wearing hospital scrubs.

grounded_facts: Jane, Selvig, and Thor arrive at the hospital parking lot, exiting the SUV with Thor needing assistance to stand.
memories.memory_text: I helped Thor to his feet after we got out of the SUV in the hospital parking lot.

grounded_facts: Jane apologizes to Thor, implying she has accidentally hit him with a car before.
memories.memory_text: I apologized to Thor because I remember accidentally hitting him with my car before, and I wanted him to know I didn't mean to do it on purpose.

grounded_facts: Thor looks at the sky and recognizes Earth based on its blue sky and single sun.

grounded_facts: Darcy jokes that Jane may have hit Thor with the car one too many times, referencing past incidents.
memories.memory_text: Darcy told me I might have hit Thor with the car one too many times, implying it wasn't the first accident.

grounded_facts: Jane decides to get Thor some clothes, indicating concern for his current state.
memories.memory_text: I decided we needed to get Thor some clothes right away because he was out there without any, and I felt concerned about how exposed he must have felt.

grounded_facts: Darcy makes a lighthearted remark about Thor's physique, noting he is 'pretty cut' despite being a 'crazy homeless guy'.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Darcy looking at Thor in the mirror and making a comment about how he was 'pretty cut' for a 'crazy homeless guy'.

grounded_facts: Darcy verbally apologizes to Thor for previously using a taser on him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Darcy apologize to Thor for tasering him earlier.

grounded_facts: Jane stops Thor from interacting with her scientific equipment out of concern for safety or integrity of the work.
memories.memory_text: I stopped Thor and led him away from the workstation because I was worried he might damage my equipment.
